structured_output.analysis:
The budget ratio 84617/26880 works out to about 3.148 average bits. iso_3.15 is at 3.14795 bits [E514ab09c524e], so any upgrade has to be paid for. For the top loss layers, the chosen method is already the best at its bit width: 27.up gptq_int3 0.00572 vs rht 0.00774 [Ef04d8aa7bded, E8972491007e7]; 3.up rht3 0.00642 vs gptq3 0.00706 [E6f4f7ea296d5, Ec98ddfd45576]; 27.gate rht3 0.00499 vs gptq3 0.00674 [Efa0bb391da67, E9eeb9841ba46]; 14.down rht2 0.00633 vs gptq2 0.00926 [E4c3f9b73e065, E811deddc975e]. So swapping methods at the same width gains nothing. Dropping a 3-bit layer to 2 bits costs a lot (about 0.02 or more on the up_proj layers), so that can't fund upgrades. That leaves two levers:
1. Options that don't change storage, such as act_order.
2. Freeing scale overhead with a larger group size (group_size=256) on the 109 rht_gptq_int3 layers, and spending it on moving 3-bit layers to 4 bits. Each such upgrade measured a single-layer gain of about 0.0035–0.004.

Measured KL was 0.436 against a prediction of 0.398 [E514ab09c524e], so interactions between layers matter.

proposals.name: iso_actorder
proposals.rationale: No change to bits. Sets act_order=true on every GPTQ-family method to reduce rounding error in the layers where loss concentrates, e.g. 27.up gptq_int3 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] and 14.down rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065]. Baseline whole-recipe KL is 0.436 [E514ab09c524e].

proposals.name: rht3_g256_up4
proposals.rationale: Sets group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 to halve its scale overhead, and spends the freed bits on four 3-to-4-bit upgrades. Measured single-layer KL: 2.up 0.00642->0.00237 [E9baa10763ebe, Ef3d9c7b4502c]; 3.up 0.00642->0.00238 [E6f4f7ea296d5, Ef4ee8cb4969e]; 1.up 0.00611->0.00227 [E0564bc6ad1eb, E779bc065b72e]; 27.gate 0.00499->0.00153 [Efa0bb391da67, Ef428ac081334].

proposals.name: rht3_g256_up3_actorder
proposals.rationale: A more conservative version with 3 upgrades, so it stays under budget, plus act_order=true to offset the error group_size=256 adds. Measured single-layer KL: 2.up 0.00642->0.00237 [E9baa10763ebe, Ef3d9c7b4502c]; 3.up 0.00642->0.00238 [E6f4f7ea296d5, Ef4ee8cb4969e]; 27.gate 0.00499->0.00153 [Efa0bb391da67, Ef428ac081334].
